coverage.method: Programmatic extraction and full-text AI semantic analysis of 105 original inventory items, cross-checked against regenerated batch files. Exhaustive structural audit of all 24 distinct tutorials and 40 distinct explanations across 182 mechanics items (g04-t2, g06-t2, g08-t3) in initial 1460 release scope. Full-catalog regex scan across all 1460 invitations for authoritarian/pressure language, and regex whole-word scan across all 1460 tutorials for premature answer leakage. This is an independent AI review; no human editorial or child-pilot claims are made.

suggestions.title: Introduce partial orders with branching for older age track (age_9_12) in future iterations
suggestions.description: Currently all g06-t2 puzzles use linear total orders where all pairwise edges are disclosed before play. This is clear, supportive, and effective for 6-8. For older children (9-12), future content drops could introduce partial orders with branching steps (multiple valid topological sorts) to provide deeper algorithmic planning challenges.
suggestions.recommendation: Optional future enhancement; no change required for current release.

suggestions.title: Consider abstract or fantasy tokens for conditional reasoning in future expansions
suggestions.description: The game-local symbolic framing "Các từ là thẻ ký hiệu. Luật chỉ dùng trong ván này." completely decouples logical deduction from real-world causality. In future expansions, using playful fictional tokens (e.g. thẻ phép thuật, huy hiệu hiệp sĩ) could make the arbitrary nature of game-local rules even more immediately intuitive to young children.
suggestions.recommendation: Optional future enhancement; current symbolic framing fully satisfies all acceptance criteria.
